يبتهجوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَهِجُوا (yabtahijū) /jab.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# يُبْتَهَجُوا (yubtahajū) /jub.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
